workflows.name: Game badge set -> voxel plaque batch
workflows.user_goal: Pull every achievement badge for a game and turn the whole set into individually-sized voxel plaques in one operation
workflows.data_shape: tree of achievement records (GetGameExtended.Achievements) -> parallel tree of badge images -> tree of voxel meshes
workflows.why_grasshopper: RA's own site shows badges one achievement at a time; GH processes the whole achievement tree as one parametric batch (quantize + voxelize every badge in the set at once, vary voxel height by e.g. Points or rarity per branch) instead of downloading and converting each badge by hand.

workflows.name: Local sprite sheet -> per-frame voxel extrusion
workflows.user_goal: Split a sprite sheet into a tree of frames and vary voxel extrusion height per frame based on a computed value (e.g. animation index)
workflows.data_shape: tree of sprite frames -> parallel tree of extrusion heights -> tree of voxel meshes
workflows.why_grasshopper: Frame-by-frame extrusion tuning in an image editor is manual per-frame work; in GH it's one tree operation with a Graph Mapper or Remap Numbers driving height per frame.

workflows.name: Palette quantization sweep across a sprite tree
workflows.user_goal: Quantize a tree of sprites/badges down to a target filament color count and preview Delta-E match before committing to fabrication
workflows.data_shape: tree of source images -> parallel tree of quantized palettes -> tree of matched filament names
workflows.why_grasshopper: Swapping palette size or filament library across dozens of sprites at once is a single parametric sweep in GH; doing it per-image in a photo editor doesn't scale.

workflows.name: Tabular pixel grid -> mosaic/voxel geometry (cross-platform benchmark)
workflows.user_goal: Take a simple tree/list of tabular data (rows x columns of RGB or palette-index values, as if from a CSV or spreadsheet) and turn it directly into mosaic or voxel geometry
workflows.data_shape: tree of rows, each a list of per-cell color/index values -> tree of placed studs/beads/LEDs/voxels
uses_fields: pixel art IS inherently a tabular RGB grid — this benchmark maps directly onto the plugin's own sprite data model
workflows.why_grasshopper: Pixel art is already a row/column grid of color values, so the standard tabular-to-platform benchmark is a first-class use case here, not a stretch: any tabular color grid (hand-authored, from a spreadsheet, or from a sprite) becomes stud/bead/LED/voxel placement with one aggregator chain.

workflows.name: Box-art-scaled laser standoff stack
workflows.user_goal: Fetch a game's box art dimensions/aspect ratio from RA and size a laser-cut standoff stack to match without manual measuring
workflows.data_shape: single game record (GetGame.ImageBoxArt) -> aspect ratio value -> parametric standoff stack geometry
workflows.why_grasshopper: Ties real fetched artwork proportions directly into parametric fabrication geometry instead of eyeballing dimensions from a downloaded image.
